newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Alaska Air estimates trim.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Alaska Air estimates trim.

text.p: Dillon, Read & Co Inc said on Monday it was lowering its second quarter earnings estimate for Alaska Air Group Inc because of slightly higher-than-forecast labor expenses, but maintaining its outperform rating.

-- Dillon, Read analyst Edward Starkman said in a research note he was lowering his second quarter diluted earnings estimate to $1.00 per share from $1.10 per share. This reduced his fully diluted 1997 estimate to $2.55 per share from $2.65.

-- Alaska Air was adding customer service personnel at a faster rate than capacity expansion levels because of robust traffic, he said. "The company is determined to maintain the high cutomer service levels that is their stock in trade. As higher expenses go, this is an excellent reason," he said.
-- The company's shares were off 3/8 at 25-1/8.
